lyrics.en: ※This translation is currently generated by AI. The refined version is coming soon!
lyrics.zh: ※此翻譯暫時是AI生成的。人工的翻譯會容後更新！

lyrics.ja: 明日へ　もっと歌おう　もっと踊ろう　笑顔のDays
lyrics.romaji: Ashita e Motto Utaou Motto Odorou Egao no Days
lyrics.en: Toward tomorrow—let's sing more, dance more—days of smiles
lyrics.zh: 走向明天，唱得更多、跳得更多，笑容的 Days

lyrics.ja: 集ったね　夢色ワンダー
lyrics.romaji: Tsudotta ne Yumeiro Wandaa
lyrics.en: We've gathered, haven't we? Dream-colored wonder
lyrics.zh: 聚集起來了呢，夢色 wonder

lyrics.ja: 期待に満ちた目で　足取りはラッタッタッタン
lyrics.romaji: Kitai ni Michita Me de Ashidori ha Rattatta Ttan
lyrics.en: With eyes full of expectation, our steps go rat-tat-tat-tan
lyrics.zh: 以充滿期待的眼神，步伐啦啦噠噠噠

lyrics.ja: 好きなことを好きなだけ　全力だけどマイペース
lyrics.romaji: Suki na Koto wo Suki na Dake Zenryoku Dakedo Mai Peesu
lyrics.en: Doing what I love as much as I love it—full power but at my own pace
lyrics.zh: 喜歡的事就盡情喜歡，全力以赴但照自己的步調

lyrics.ja: 手探りだっていいじゃん
lyrics.romaji: Tesaguri Datte Ii jan
lyrics.en: It's okay to feel your way along, isn't it?
lyrics.zh: 摸索前進也沒關係吧

lyrics.ja: トキメキの行方は　刺激的
lyrics.romaji: Tokimeki no Yukue ha Shigekiteki
lyrics.en: Where the excitement leads is thrilling
lyrics.zh: 心動的去向，刺激無比

lyrics.ja: 色とりどりの光が
lyrics.romaji: Irotoridori no Hikari ga
lyrics.en: Lights of every color
lyrics.zh: 五顏六色的光芒

lyrics.ja: 集ったね　夢色ワンダー
lyrics.romaji: Tsudotta ne Yumeiro Wandaa
lyrics.en: We've gathered, haven't we? Dream-colored wonder
lyrics.zh: 聚集起來了呢，夢色 wonder

lyrics.ja: その顔　声　思い出全て　抱きしめながら生きている
lyrics.romaji: Sono Kao Koe Omoide Subete Dakishime Nagara Ikite Iru
lyrics.en: That face, that voice, all the memories—I live while holding them close
lyrics.zh: 那張臉、那個聲音、所有回憶，我都緊抱著活下去

lyrics.ja: にぎやかな　笑い声いつまでも　どこまでも続いてく
lyrics.romaji: Nigiyaka na Waraigoe Itsu made mo Doko made mo Tsuzuiteku
lyrics.en: The lively laughter goes on forever, anywhere at all
lyrics.zh: 熱鬧的笑聲永遠、無論何處都會延續下去

lyrics.ja: それぞれのやり方で　それぞれの生き様で
lyrics.romaji: Sorezore no Yarikata de Sorezore no Ikizama de
lyrics.en: In each of our own ways, in each of our own lives
lyrics.zh: 以各自的方式，以各自的生存姿態

lyrics.ja: 会えないとき(いつか)　寂しいとき(いつか)　乗り越え強さになる
lyrics.romaji: Aenai Toki (Itsuka) Sabishii Toki (Itsuka) Norikoe Tsuyosa ni Naru
lyrics.en: Times we can't meet (someday), times we're lonely (someday)—we overcome them and become stronger
lyrics.zh: 見不到的時候（總有一天）寂寞的時候（總有一天），跨越過去就會化為堅強

lyrics.ja: 胸の奥問いかけて　鼓動導く方へ
lyrics.romaji: Mune no Oku Toikakete Kodou Michibiku Hou e
lyrics.en: Questioning deep in my chest, toward where my heartbeat leads
lyrics.zh: 詢問胸口深處，朝心跳引導的方向

lyrics.ja: 心からつながるあたたかさ
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro kara Tsunagaru Atatakasa
lyrics.en: The warmth of being connected from the heart
lyrics.zh: 從心相繫的溫暖

lyrics.ja: 叶える力　輪になって　どんどん広がる
lyrics.romaji: Kanaeru Chikara Wa ni Natte Dondon Hirogaru
lyrics.en: The power to make things come true forms a circle and keeps spreading
lyrics.zh: 實現的力量圍成圈，不斷擴散

lyrics.ja: 大きなエナジー
lyrics.romaji: Ookina Enajii
lyrics.en: A great energy
lyrics.zh: 巨大的能量

lyrics.ja: 世界を覆ってくこのカオス
lyrics.romaji: Sekai wo Ootteku Kono Kaosu
lyrics.en: This chaos that covers the world
lyrics.zh: 覆蓋世界的這份混沌

lyrics.ja: 楽しさ　探す　探す　夢祭り
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshisa Sagasu Sagasu Yume Matsuri
lyrics.en: Searching, searching for fun—a dream festival
lyrics.zh: 尋找、尋找樂趣，夢想祭典

lyrics.ja: 昨日のあなたも(It's you)　今日の私も(It's me)
lyrics.romaji: Kinou no Anata mo (It's You) Kyou no Watashi mo (It's Me)
lyrics.en: Yesterday's you too (it's you), today's me too (it's me)
lyrics.zh: 昨天的你也是（It's you），今天的我也是（It's me）

lyrics.ja: 絆のマーチ　進め　さあ行こう
lyrics.romaji: Kizuna no Maachi Susume Saa Ikou
lyrics.en: The march of bonds—advance, now let's go
lyrics.zh: 羈絆的進行曲，前進吧，來吧出發

lyrics.ja: 明日へ　もっと歌おう　もっと踊ろう　笑顔のDays
lyrics.romaji: Ashita e Motto Utaou Motto Odorou Egao no Days
lyrics.en: Toward tomorrow—let's sing more, dance more—days of smiles
lyrics.zh: 走向明天，唱得更多、跳得更多，笑容的 Days

lyrics.ja: そうだ　かけがえないこのときを　遊び尽くそう
lyrics.romaji: Sou Da Kakegae Nai Kono Toki wo Asobitsukusou
lyrics.en: That's right—let's play this irreplaceable moment to the fullest
lyrics.zh: 沒錯，把這無可取代的時刻玩到淋漓盡致吧

lyrics.ja: 未来へ　もっと描こう　もっと作ろう　幸せSunrise
lyrics.romaji: Mirai e Motto Egakou Motto Tsukurou Shiawase Sunrise
lyrics.en: Toward the future—let's draw more, create more—a happy sunrise
lyrics.zh: 走向未來，描繪更多、創造更多，幸福的 Sunrise

lyrics.ja: 想像を超えた景色を　みんなで迎えてたいよ
lyrics.romaji: Souzou wo Koeta Keshiki wo Minna de Mukaete Tai yo
lyrics.en: I want us all to welcome a scenery beyond imagination
lyrics.zh: 想和大家一起迎接超越想像的景色

lyrics.ja: 近くて　遠くて　そばにある
lyrics.romaji: Chikakute Tookute Soba ni Aru
lyrics.en: Close yet far, yet right beside us
lyrics.zh: 既近又遠，卻就在身邊

lyrics.ja: 魔法みたいなワクワク　奇跡みたいなドキドキ
lyrics.romaji: Mahou Mitai na Wakuwaku Kiseki Mitai na Dokidoki
lyrics.en: Excitement like magic, heart-pounding like miracles
lyrics.zh: 像魔法般的興奮，像奇蹟般的心跳

lyrics.ja: まるっとね　詰め込んで
lyrics.romaji: Marutto ne Tsumekonde
lyrics.en: Packing it all in, completely
lyrics.zh: 整個通通裝進去

lyrics.ja: 山を越え　海を越え　空を越え　星を越え　時を越えて　遥か
lyrics.romaji: Yama wo Koe Umi wo Koe Sora wo Koe Hoshi wo Koe Toki wo Koete Haruka
lyrics.en: Over mountains, over seas, over skies, over stars, over time—far beyond
lyrics.zh: 越過山、越過海、越過天、越過星、越過時間，遙遠地

lyrics.ja: のぞいてみて　寄ってみて
lyrics.romaji: Nozoite Mite Yotte Mite
lyrics.en: Try peeking in, try coming closer
lyrics.zh: 試著窺探看看，試著靠近看看

lyrics.ja: 集ったね　夢色ワンダー
lyrics.romaji: Tsudotta ne Yumeiro Wandaa
lyrics.en: We've gathered, haven't we? Dream-colored wonder
lyrics.zh: 聚集起來了呢，夢色 wonder

lyrics.ja: キラメキ残る軌跡　神秘的
lyrics.romaji: Kirameki Nokoru Kiseki Shinpiteki
lyrics.en: A轨迹 where sparkles remain—mysterious
lyrics.zh: 留下閃耀的軌跡，神秘無比

lyrics.ja: 色鮮やかな願いが
lyrics.romaji: Iro Azayaka na Negai ga
lyrics.en: Vividly colored wishes
lyrics.zh: 色彩鮮豔的願望

lyrics.ja: 紡いでく　夢色ワンダー
lyrics.romaji: Tsumuideku Yumeiro Wandaa
lyrics.en: Spin onward—dream-colored wonder
lyrics.zh: 持續編織，夢色 wonder

lyrics.ja: 病めるとき　健やかなとき
lyrics.romaji: Yameru Toki Sukoyaka na Toki
lyrics.en: In sickness and in health
lyrics.zh: 無論病痛之時，還是健康之時

lyrics.ja: 隣にいるから　力になるから
lyrics.romaji: Tonari ni Iru kara Chikara ni Naru kara
lyrics.en: Because I'm by your side, because I'll become your strength
lyrics.zh: 因為我在你身旁，因為會成為你的力量

lyrics.ja: 愛の鳴る方へ
lyrics.romaji: Ai no Naru Hou e
lyrics.en: Toward where love rings
lyrics.zh: 朝愛鳴響的方向

lyrics.ja: 耳すます　耳すます　何聴こえる？
lyrics.romaji: Mimi Sumasu Mimi Sumasu Nani Kikoeru?
lyrics.en: Listening closely, listening closely—what do you hear?
lyrics.zh: 側耳傾聽、側耳傾聽，聽見什麼？

lyrics.ja: 目をこらす　目をこらす　何見える？
lyrics.romaji: Me wo Korasu Me wo Korasu Nani Mieru?
lyrics.en: Straining my eyes, straining my eyes—what do you see?
lyrics.zh: 凝神細看、凝神細看，看見什麼？

lyrics.ja: 触れてみる　触れてみる　感じてる(ふわふわして)
lyrics.romaji: Furete Miru Furete Miru Kanjiteru (Fuwafuwa Shite)
lyrics.en: Trying to touch, trying to touch—I'm feeling it (fluffy and soft)
lyrics.zh: 試著觸碰、試著觸碰，正在感受（輕飄飄的）

lyrics.ja: 声に出す　声に出す　心のシークレット(ぐるぐるして)
lyrics.romaji: Koe ni Dasu Koe ni Dasu Kokoro no Shiikuretto (Guruguru Shite)
lyrics.en: Voicing it, voicing it—the heart's secret (spinning round and round)
lyrics.zh: 說出口、說出口，心中的秘密（團團轉）

lyrics.ja: (もじもじなシークレット)
lyrics.romaji: (Mojimoji na Shiikuretto)
lyrics.en: (A fidgety secret)
lyrics.zh: （扭扭捏捏的秘密）

lyrics.ja: 喜びも　悲しみも　全部全部
lyrics.romaji: Yorokobi mo Kanashimi mo Zenbu Zenbu
lyrics.en: Joy and sorrow—all of it, all of it
lyrics.zh: 喜悅也好，悲傷也好，全部全部

lyrics.ja: 持ってきなよ　一緒に開けよう
lyrics.romaji: Motte Kina yo Issho ni Akeyou
lyrics.en: Bring it all—let's open it together
lyrics.zh: 全都帶來吧，一起打開吧

lyrics.ja: 広がって　いつまでも　いつまでも　笑顔のDays
lyrics.romaji: Hirogatte Itsu made mo Itsu made mo Egao no Days
lyrics.en: Spreading out—forever and ever—days of smiles
lyrics.zh: 擴散開來，永遠永遠，笑容的 Days

lyrics.ja: そうだ　かけがえないこのときを　遊び尽くそう
lyrics.romaji: Sou Da Kakegae Nai Kono Toki wo Asobitsukusou
lyrics.en: That's right—let's play this irreplaceable moment to the fullest
lyrics.zh: 沒錯，把這無可取代的時刻玩到淋漓盡致吧

lyrics.ja: 信じて　描くのは特大の　幸せSunrise
lyrics.romaji: Shinjite Egaku no ha Tokudai no Shiawase Sunrise
lyrics.en: Believing and drawing is an extra-large happy sunrise
lyrics.zh: 相信並描繪的是特大號的，幸福 Sunrise

lyrics.ja: 想像を超えた景色を　みんなで迎えてたいよ
lyrics.romaji: Souzou wo Koeta Keshiki wo Minna de Mukaete Tai yo
lyrics.en: I want us all to welcome a scenery beyond imagination
lyrics.zh: 想和大家一起迎接超越想像的景色

lyrics.romaji: Chikakute Tookute Soba ni Aru
lyrics.en: Close yet far, yet right beside us
lyrics.zh: 既近又遠，卻就在身邊

lyrics.ja: 魔法みたいなワクワク　奇跡みたいなドキドキ
lyrics.romaji: Mahou Mitai na Wakuwaku Kiseki Mitai na Dokidoki
lyrics.en: Excitement like magic, heart-pounding like miracles
lyrics.zh: 像魔法般的興奮，像奇蹟般的心跳

lyrics.romaji: Marutto ne Tsumekonde
lyrics.en: Packing it all in, completely
lyrics.zh: 整個通通裝進去

lyrics.romaji: Yama wo Koe Umi wo Koe Sora wo Koe Hoshi wo Koe Toki wo Koete Haruka
lyrics.en: Over mountains, over seas, over skies, over stars, over time—far beyond
lyrics.zh: 越過山、越過海、越過天、越過星、越過時間，遙遠地

lyrics.ja: のぞいてみて　寄ってみて
lyrics.romaji: Nozoite Mite Yotte Mite
lyrics.en: Try peeking in, try coming closer
lyrics.zh: 試著窺探看看，試著靠近看看

lyrics.ja: 明日のその先　生きてくその姿　その想いが
lyrics.romaji: Ashita no Sono Saki Ikiteku Sono Sugata Sono Omoi ga
lyrics.en: Beyond tomorrow—that way of living, those feelings
lyrics.zh: 明天的更前方，活下去的那身影、那份思念

lyrics.ja: 紡いでく　夢色ワンダー
lyrics.romaji: Tsumuideku Yumeiro Wandaa
lyrics.en: Spin onward—dream-colored wonder
lyrics.zh: 持續編織，夢色 wonder
